scope: slice 9 progress-stats frontend (implement-progress-stats-ui): the admin stats page /admin/stats (success metric, weekly table, week count, first-try rate per topic, empty state), the admin flag queue /admin/reports (reports with task, reason, note, attached attempt, raw input in full, both verdicts, status filter, re-evaluate, dismiss, outcome line), the admin navigation entries, ISO admin dates, and the admin contract stub's stats and flag queue (src/test/fake-progress-backend.ts)

findings.title: A 409 refusal moves no focus, and the pressed button can unmount, dropping focus to <body>
Short weeks are hidden when the shown weeks are empty but older practice exists (the 'no practice' check only looks at the shown weeks)
The 'unchanged' outcome always says the attempt is still not correct, which is wrong for other changed:false reasons
The e2e wrap assertion for long raw input is vacuous for an inline span
A failed refetch after an action is ignored while cached data exists, so a stale queue still offers actions
Stale doc comments describe a date format the code no longer produces
Empty state is decided from the shown weeks only: it hides every Short mark and can say 'No practice recorded yet' when practice did happen
After a 409 refusal, focus is not moved to the outcome and can fall to <body>
The e2e 'wrapped' assertion for long raw input can never fail; wrapping and U+00A0 inputs are not actually checked
Dismiss outcome copy differs from the scenario text
Doc comments still describe the old word-style dates
The part-key column is very narrow and its keys do not wrap under table-layout: fixed
Stub fidelity: the excerpt cuts UTF-16 code units, the topic list differs, and the re-evaluation rule is simplified
findings.reason: Excerpt now cut by code points (fixed in bd732c8). The remainder is waived: the stub lists every reference topic in firstTryRateByTopic and requires every part CORRECT for a replay fix; the UI renders whatever topics and verdicts the server serves, so neither difference changes what the UI does. The backend notes (scratch/slice9-backend-behaviour.md, 2026-10-07) were re-read before the gate and are folded into design.md.
